name: – Andrey Novakov – Joint text
title: REPORT on the joint text approved by the Conciliation Committee for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 establishing common rules on compensation and assistance to passengers in the event of denied boarding and of cancellation or long delay of flights and Regulation (EC) No 2027/97 on air carrier liability in respect of the carriage of passengers and their baggage by air
part_text:
The report approves a deal between the European Parliament and the Council of the European Union on new rules for air passengers. It keeps the current compensation amounts of 250, 400 and 600 Euro and the three-hour delay threshold. Airlines must tell passengers about their right to compensation after a disruption. Children under 14 sit next to their parents for free, and passengers can use a paper or digital boarding pass at no cost.

- Airlines must include a piece of hand baggage in the price shown and cannot charge for printed boarding passes.
- Passengers with disabilities, unaccompanied minors and people with damaged equipment get clearer rights to help and compensation.
- The agreed text now goes to a final vote in Parliament; if approved, it becomes law across the European Union.
